# telnyx_agent_gateway_teams (Data Source)

Lists agent gateway teams, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_agent_gateway_team`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gateway_id` (String) The gateway id.

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `agent_gateway_teams` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agent_gateway_teams))

<a id="nestedatt--agent_gateway_teams"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agent_gateway_teams`

Read-Only:

- `blocked` (Boolean) Whether the instance refuses every key in the team.
- `budget_resets_at` (String) When the team's spend next resets.
- `budget_resets_every` (String) How often the team's spend resets, such as `30d`.
- `created_at` (String) When the team was created.
- `id` (String) Identifies the team.
- `max_budget` (Number) The most the team's keys may spend together, in USD, until the budget resets.
- `models` (Set of String) The models the team's keys may use. Empty means every model the instance serves.
- `name` (String) A label for people. Names need not be unique.
- `requests_per_minute` (Number) The most requests the team's keys may make per minute, together.
- `spend` (Number) What the team's keys have spent since the budget last reset, in USD.
- `tokens_per_minute` (Number) The most tokens the team's keys may use per minute, together.
